text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Waaagh, it's an emergency! I spilled the milk, Fuku!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Eeeek, it's coming this way! Spilt milk, or any liquids that be, depart from this room immediately!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur (From the Hallway)
text_block_list.text: Shut up!

text_block_list.name: The Matikanes
text_block_list.text: Eep! We're sorry!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Sigh… We got yelled at yet again…

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Yeah… Our room gets so noisy, it's no wonder people call it the "jump scare room."

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Grrr… We mustn't let our reputation sink any further! In order to cleanse our record…

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Let's hit the streets tomorrow and really have some fun! That way, we'll use up all our energy!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Makes sense to me. Okie-dokie, let's put the P in party!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: First up, we've gotta sing some karaoke! Health is weaaalth! Disasters begooone!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Whoooa-oooh! We are the Matikaneeees! ♪

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Now let's get down and boogie! Hoppity, woopity, woop!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Dum-dee-dum, doopee-doo! ♪ La-di-daa!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: And now to get everything off our chests! Let's scream it from the rooftops!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: MY FORTUNES ONLY HAVE A FIFTY-FIFTY CHANCE OF COMING TRUUUE!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: YES, I MIGHT BE WISHY-WASHY, BUT… BUT! I DON'T KNOW WHAT TO SAY RIGHT NOOOW!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Phew, we really put ourselves to work today, huh, Fuku?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I spent my very last drop of energy… I better get some sleep, like now…

text_block_list.name: The Matikanes
text_block_list.text: Snoooooore! Snooooorkhh!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur (From the Hallway)
text_block_list.text: SHUT UUUP!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The dorm continues to rumble with snores and angry yelling.
